claim_text: U.S. President Donald Trump has promised $5,000 to every American adult if the Republicans win majority control of the Senate and House of Representatives in the 2026 midterm elections.
query: U.S. President Donald Trump has promised $5 000 to every American adult
summary: When asked by Fox News host Laura Ingraham on Thursday “if you have the money, why not give it now,” Trump said Democrats had produced “negative growth” while growth under Republicans has been “so positive.” (Real GDP grew annually throughout Biden’s presidency, as it has also done in Trump’s second term.) In his first term, Trump authorized two rounds of congressionally-approved stimulus checks during the COVID-19 pandemic. “The doomers and naysayers have consistently doubted President Trump: when he pledged to create the historic Trump Accounts, lowered prescription prices with Most Favored Nations, secured the border with no crossings, cleaned up our streets, ended taxes on tips, grew real wages, renegotiated broken trade deals, and reshored key manufacturing back to the United States,” Ingle said. Apart from the $5,000 promise, Trump’s address was not very different from his typical rally speech, touching on issues he often speaks about, including tariffs, the importance of destroying Iran’s nuclear program, passing a bill to limit voter identification and registration rules and claiming lower inflation than when he took office.
